public_price_contract.exactness: Map decimal strings directly to Decimal. Reject doubles, exponent notation, nonpositive prices/sizes, crossed book, invalid symbols/time/IDs. No chart depth doubles enter money calculations.
public_price_contract.time_and_replay: Use exchange transaction T for stream freshness, not event E. Compare receipt age and calibrated transaction age against ten seconds, allow at most ten seconds future skew. Clock-request RTT contributes to the conservative expiry bound. Reject slow/backward/invalid clock calibration. Aggregate l shares the raw REST trade-id watermark; duplicate/replayed messages cannot renew receipt freshness.
public_price_contract.race_and_lifecycle: Separate book/trade bootstrap failures; 250ms stream coalescing, one-second expiry publication. Quote identity and channel revision prevent late REST from replacing or healing subsequent stream events, including malformed events. Offline clears verified freshness; reconnect calibrates clock and obtains new public snapshots. Late old-session responses are ignored. No listener means no requests; last cancellation, pause and disposal release transport/timers.

signed_fact_read_change.scope: Current symbol orders remain isolated for the existing signed preview. MainOrderAccountFacts retains the complete account order list and validated tiers for the selected symbol plus every occupied cross symbol.
signed_fact_read_change.weight_change: Official openOrders request weight changes from 1 (symbol) to 40 (all symbols). One explicit read, no polling. leverageBrackets weight remains 1.
signed_fact_read_change.risk_validation: Unscoped array required; duplicate/missing symbols rejected. Requested risk rows validate contiguous notional intervals, leverage, nondecreasing maintenance ratios and exact cumulative continuity through existing strict margin-tier mapper.
signed_fact_read_change.safety: Same EOA user/signer, no wallet creation. Existing identity, cancellation and original 30-second account-context deadline remain. No new write requests. Five separate reads are not an atomic exchange snapshot.

revaluation_kernel.inputs: Validated signed snapshot with account-wide marketFacts; per-symbol exact fresh marks and reference Last, selected bid/ask, current asset indices and explicit now. It has no transport or widget side effects.
revaluation_kernel.pnl: For each related nonzero cross position compute min(q*(Mark-entry),q*(Last-entry)) independently, then sum by margin asset. Exclude isolated PnL from shared budgets.
revaluation_kernel.exposure: Reprice signed notional q*Mark. One-way reservation=max(abs(N+opening buy pending notional),abs(N-opening sell pending notional)); hedge adds both held legs and their opening orders. Fixed LIMIT pending notional=remainingQty*price. Closing legs reserve no new opening amount.
revaluation_kernel.single_cross: crossWallet + freshly recomputed cross PnL - cross initial margin - isolated extra pending margin. Initial/extra margin divisions remain Rational.
revaluation_kernel.single_isolated: min(single-cross budget, crossWallet - freshly computed cross maintenance - isolated extra pending margin). Maintenance is abs(notional)*tier.rate-tier.cumulative, with exact tier boundary selection.
revaluation_kernel.multi_cross: [sum min((crossWallet+newCrossPnl)*bidRate,(crossWallet+newCrossPnl)*askRate) - sum newCrossInitialMargin*askRate] / target askRate. Include only marginAvailable assets. Preserve negative collateral; require complete fresh valid rates. Active isolated exposure is unsupported.
revaluation_kernel.identity: Return a separate MainOrderRevaluation referring to the original snapshot. The repriced LiveOrderContext retains the original receivedAt, rules/configuration/funds/position identity; prices cannot renew the signed deadline or mutate any approved quantity.
revaluation_kernel.unknowns: Missing/stale/offline/invalid required quotes, unknown pending reservations, missing account order configuration, missing/out-of-range risk tiers or invalid indices reject the entire valuation. Zero is not an unknown placeholder.

boundaries: This increment does not claim a live UI or submit-guard integration. Current production capacity preview/submission continues using the previously verified bounded snapshot path.
The public exact-reference repository currently handles one selected symbol, not an all-position aggregate socket.
The kernel recomputes from complete position/order facts; it deliberately does not reuse signed availableBalance, crossUnPnl or initialMargin as if updated by new public prices.
Signed account/orders/configuration responses are not atomic; real endpoint scope/permissions/last-place parity still require authorized acceptance.
Negative budget remains negative in the valuation; capacity arithmetic is responsible for a known-zero maximum.
No real wallet/private/funds requests, address RPC, installation, device tooling, commit or push in this increment. iOS requires macOS/Xcode; native tests remain deferred by user.
